proof_text:
unfold Compare Compare_postcond
  have h_main : (a = b → Compare a b h_precond = true) ∧ (a ≠ b → Compare a b h_precond = false) := by
    constructor
    · -- Prove the first implication: if a = b then Compare a b h_precond = true
      intro h
      simp [Compare, h]
    · -- Prove the second implication: if a ≠ b then Compare a b h_precond = false
      intro h
      simp [Compare, h]
      <;> aesop
  exact h_main
